req.title: Create new post
req.statement: The system shall insert a new post attributed to the logged-in user when POST /create receives a title and body, then redirect to /.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the 'Create new post' functionality by covering positive, negative, and boundary cases. The positive test ensures that a valid post is created and redirects correctly. The negative test checks for missing title input, which should trigger an error. The boundary test examines the behavior when the title is exactly one character long, ensuring the system handles minimal valid input.

tests.name: test_create_post_success
actions: POST /create with valid title and body.
expected: Post is inserted into the database.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as 'test'
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})

# Create a new post
r = client.post('/create', data={'title': 'New Post', 'body': 'This is a new post.'})

# Assertions
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: test_create_post_missing_title
expected: Error message 'Title is required.' is flashed.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as 'test'
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})

# Attempt to create a post with missing title
r = client.post('/create', data={'title': '', 'body': 'This is a new post.'})

# Assertions
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Title is required.' in r.data
